Sulfuric acid plant Anaconda Copper 1920
Sulfuric acid plant of the Washoe Works of the Anaconda Copper in 1920. It supplies the needs of the flotation process and of the leaching department for acid. This plant uses the fumes produced by the roasting of concentrate in McDougall furnaces.
